description: This Java source file defines the AccountsApiResource class, which is a RESTful API resource handling operations related to share accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, creating, updating, and performing various commands (approve, reject, redeem, etc.) on share accounts, as well as handling bulk import templates.

classes.name: AccountsApiResource
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing share accounts, including retrieving templates, accounts, creating, updating, and executing commands like approval and redemption. It supports bulk import operations for account data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a share account template with default values and options based on client and product IDs.

methods.name: retrieveAccount
methods.description: Gets details of a specific share account by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccounts
methods.description: Lists all share accounts with optional pagination.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Submits a new share account application.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Performs various commands on a share account such as approve, reject, redeem, etc., based on the command parameter.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Modifies an existing share account application in 'submitted' state.

methods.name: getSharedAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of share accounts.

methods.name: postSharedAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Handles uploading of an Excel file to import share accounts in bulk.
